I. Ensuring your safety and security is paramount when engaging in peer-to-peer transactions on our esteemed marketplace and navigation app. To safeguard against individuals with ill intentions masquerading as students, we strongly recommend arranging meetings exclusively within the confines of your campus grounds. Leveraging the integrated navigator feature, our app empowers you to effortlessly locate designated meeting spots, eliminating any uncertainties surrounding their whereabouts. Please bear in mind that while the campus grounds provide a level of security, exercising caution remains essential, and it is advisable to schedule meetings during daylight hours.

II. Maintaining a prudent approach to monetary transactions is pivotal. We advise against remitting payment to the seller until you have unequivocally verified the physical presence of the book in the buyer's possession. Simultaneously, it is crucial to confirm that the buyer is prepared to facilitate the exchange promptly upon receipt of payment. Likewise, sellers should exercise vigilance and ensure the buyer's commitment to remunerate them prior to relinquishing possession of their book. By adhering to these guidelines, you fortify the integrity of the transaction and mitigate potential risks.

III. Should you opt to convene outside the confines of the campus grounds, it is vital to exercise caution and assume personal responsibility for any associated risks. Please be aware that Nuclear Software (Pty) Ltd cannot be held liable for any untoward incidents transpiring during off-campus meetings. We strongly encourage you to evaluate the circumstances prudently and prioritize your safety above all else when making such arrangements.

IV. Embracing the fundamental tenets of privacy protection, we have developed a robust chat system within the Qampus app, purposefully designed to facilitate meeting arrangements whilst safeguarding your personal information. We implore you to utilize this secure channel for all communication pertaining to rendezvous details. By doing so, you can confidently engage in transactions without inadvertently compromising your sensitive data.

V. Prioritizing transparency and facilitating seamless interactions, we recommend verifying that the individual you plan to meet with has a profile picture associated with their Qampus account. This simple yet effective measure enables you to readily identify the person you are expecting when embarking on the exchange. By familiarizing yourself with their visage in advance, you can enhance the safety and efficiency of your transactional encounter.

At Qampus, we hold your safety, security, and overall experience in the highest regard. These carefully crafted safety tips serve as a steadfast foundation for fostering a secure and trustworthy peer-to-peer marketplace. Together, let us cultivate a community that thrives on integrity, professionalism, and peace of mind.
